purpose: Make terminal and web two ingress surfaces into one FranKenstein/GRID10/UnifiedDB cognitive path, with the local Frankenstein harness as the primary execution fabric and ephemeral workers as execution organs.

correlation_envelope.database_projection_rule: Each existing database/store receives only its domain-specific record through its canonical writer, correlated to the same parent turn. Do not mirror raw conversation/state blindly into every SQLite database.

main_organ_identity.fallback_rule: Alternative models may run only as explicitly identified workers/fallback execution organs. They must not silently impersonate the owner-facing main organ response.
main_organ_identity.on_main_organ_unavailable: Expose an explicit DEGRADED/MAIN_ORGAN_UNAVAILABLE state unless owner policy explicitly selects another main organ.

acceptance_tests.pass: One `frank --once` prompt creates exactly one request identity and exactly one canonical GRID10 turn/frame, with no second terminal-only turn loop.
Terminal prompt reaches the ChatGPT organ, the organ result returns to the same terminal request, and pre/post GRID10/reentry evidence is correlated.
No second cognitive DB/state authority is created by terminal, web, worker or fallback paths; all domain writes resolve to existing canonical writers/stores.
Every spawned worker has parent request/turn identity, bounded scope, resource admission and terminal lifecycle visibility; worker completion does not mint independent canonical state.
Failure of the ChatGPT main-organ path cannot silently replace the owner-facing response with Sonnet/Opus/GLM/Kimi/etc.; any alternate model is explicitly labeled as a worker/fallback organ.
Every real host effect carries machine_id+owner and a durable receipt/readback bound to the parent turn.
Local fan-out fails closed when current host telemetry is unknown/red and respects configured RAM/tab/process limits.
A later terminal or web turn re-enters the same persistent entity path while preserving host/runtime provenance; changing ingress does not create a new brain.

promotion_rule: Do not mark this ACCEPTED until one real end-to-end terminal prompt proves T1-T8 at the claimed scope.
